conditional_vae.notes: Both loss terms decrease smoothly and plateau by epoch 40. No instability signals.

wgan_gp.notes: Discriminator loss collapses toward near-zero by epoch 21 and stays there while generator loss plateaus rather than continuing to improve -- consistent with early, partial mode collapse.

stable_diffusion_finetune.notes: Denoising loss decreases smoothly throughout training with no instability signals. DreamBooth fine-tuning does not exhibit adversarial training dynamics.

metric_definitions.fid: Frechet Inception Distance -- lower is better (closer distributional match to real images)
metric_definitions.lpips: Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity -- lower is better (closer per-image perceptual match)
metric_definitions.inference_latency_ms_per_image: Wall-clock time to generate one image, in milliseconds, on the same reference GPU for all three models
